nodes.name: TPUSA Halftime Viewership Authenticity
nodes.description: Investigative target: The discrepancy between Andrew Kolvet's claimed TPUSA halftime viewership metrics (6M–20M+ concurrent) and the YouTube screenshot metrics (5,839 views / 175 comments / 667,000 likes), plus the comment-to-view ratio anomaly.

nodes.name: Hamptons Meeting Characterization Evolution
nodes.description: Investigative target: Evolution in Seth Dillon's characterization of the Hamptons meeting, from prior "spirited debate" framing to current on-the-record admission of "heated" debate about Israel.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk
nodes.description: Primary investigative subject of the series; relevant in this episode as the victim whose case is being reopened.

nodes.name: Erika Kirk
nodes.description: Subject of the NYT op-ed (A-2348) and named in the Vance-referenced grief account.

nodes.name: Tyler Bowyer
nodes.description: TPUSA figure the host questions over X posts, security-adjacent roles, and timeline overlaps with Erika Kirk.

claims.label: Nielsen Super Bowl Viewership Increase During Halftime
claims.claim: Nielsen estimates 128 million viewers watched the Super Bowl game, increasing to 135 million during the halftime performance.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary Nielsen release or interim report to confirm the 128M / 135M figures.

claims.label: Kolvet Initial Six Million Concurrent YouTube Claim
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated the TPUSA halftime show drew 6 million concurrent YouTube viewers.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Kolvet's interview statement against any contemporaneous social media archives or third-party tracking data.

claims.label: Kolvet Ten Million Concurrent Across Social Claim
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated TPUSA saw "over 10 million concurrent views" across all social channels (Rumble plus partners).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether the 10M figure is supported by any third-party analytics for Rumble or YouTube.

claims.label: Kolvet Twenty Million Total Across Social Claim
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated TPUSA had "over 20 million viewers across just social" for the halftime show.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 20M aggregate figure against partner broadcaster analytics if/when released.

claims.label: TPUSA Halftime YouTube Screenshot Metrics
claims.claim: A YouTube screenshot of the TPUSA halftime show page displayed 5,839 views, 175 comments, and 667,000 likes.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the YouTube page and timestamp the screenshot for ratio analysis.

claims.label: India Moon Mission Top YouTube Live Stream
claims.claim: Per the displayed reference list, an Indian moon mission event held the top YouTube concurrent live stream at 8 million viewers.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 8M figure against YouTube's official records or contemporaneous reporting.

claims.label: 2022 World Cup Second on YouTube Live Streams List
claims.claim: Per the displayed reference list, the 2022 World Cup Brazil vs Croatia match held the second-place position with 6.1 million concurrent YouTube viewers.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 6.1M figure against YouTube's official records or contemporaneous reporting.

claims.label: Erica Kirk Widow Address View Counts
claims.claim: Erica Kirk's widow address video on Charlie Kirk's YouTube channel has approximately 4.1 million views and 36,000 comments.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current YouTube view and comment counts on the Charlie Kirk channel.

claims.label: Candace "Letter to Erika" View Counts
claims.claim: Candace Owens' "Letter to Erika" YouTube video has approximately 3.1 million views and 28,000 comments.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current YouTube view and comment counts on Candace Owens' channel.

claims.label: TPUSA Halftime Show View-to-Comment Ratio
claims.claim: The TPUSA halftime show YouTube page reportedly has over 20 million views but only 46,000 comments.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-check current YouTube view and comment counts; compute ratio comparison against authentic videos of similar scale.

claims.label: Thomas Martin LinkedIn Profile
claims.claim: A LinkedIn profile lists Thomas Martin as Director, US Border Patrol, with location in the Greater Tucson area.
claims.investigative_direction: Attempt to retrieve LinkedIn snapshot via archive; cross-check against federal personnel directories.

claims.label: Thomas Martin ZoomInfo DHS Profile
claims.claim: A ZoomInfo listing shows Thomas Martin as Deputy Chief Patrol Agent at the Department of Homeland Security, with 9 years in Customs and Border Protection.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve ZoomInfo archive; cross-check federal personnel records.

claims.label: Thomas Martin as 1985 Border Patrol Agent
claims.claim: A 1985 Times Union article identifies agent Thomas Martin of the Border Patrol in Tucson in the context of the sanctuary movement trial.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full text of the 1985 Times Union article and verify Thomas Martin's role and tenure.

claims.label: Thomas Martin 1985 Memo on Church Invasions
claims.claim: In the 1985 article, Thomas Martin is quoted writing to superiors about avoiding "border patrol baiting" related to invading churches.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full text and verify direct quote attribution.

claims.label: Tracy's Daughter Scheduled at UVU September 10
claims.claim: Per Tracy Martin's text messages from September 11, Tracy's daughter (allegedly Erica Kirk's assistant) was scheduled to attend UVU on September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate text messages; verify daughter's attendance plans through UVU records or eyewitnesses.

claims.label: Tracy's Bad Feeling Stopped Daughter from UVU
claims.claim: Per Tracy Martin's text messages, Tracy had a "bad feeling" about September 10 and stopped her daughter from attending UVU.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate text messages; cross-reference with daughter's subsequent statements or activities.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Religious Liberty Commission Testimony
claims.claim: Seth Dillon testified at a Religious Liberty Commission hearing on antisemitism.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain official hearing transcript or recording.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Hamptons "Save the West" Characterization
claims.claim: Seth Dillon characterized the Hamptons retreat as having a "save the West" theme with primary focus on "the threat of Islam."
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with prior Hamptons participants' public statements and any contemporaneous notes.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Hamptons Heated Debate Admission
claims.claim: Seth Dillon admitted the Hamptons meeting included "heated and spirited debate about the issue of Israel."
claims.investigative_direction: Compare admission against earlier public statements by Hamptons participants and Charlie Kirk's own descriptions.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Charlie-Originated Debate Claim
claims.claim: Seth Dillon claimed Charlie Kirk himself initiated the Israel discussion at the Hamptons meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with Charlie Kirk's own public statements about the Hamptons meeting.

claims.label: Carrie Prejean Bowler Questioned Seth Dillon
claims.claim: Carrie Prejean Bowler questioned Seth Dillon at the Religious Liberty Commission hearing regarding antisemitism and the Hamptons meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full hearing transcript.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer TPUSA Concurrent Stream Tweet
claims.claim: Tyler Bowyer tweeted that TPUSA ended up with "one of the largest YouTube concurrent live streams in history."
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the original tweet and any associated image; verify whether it remains public.

claims.label: AO Comment on Erika Lights Flickering Confirmation
claims.claim: Commenter "AO" states there is a clip of Erika speaking to Megan Kelly that confirms Candace Owens' recollection of lights flickering near Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the referenced clip of Erika Kirk speaking to Megan Kelly.

claims.label: GN2176 Book Comparison Comment
claims.claim: Commenter GN2176 states that the Charlie Kirk story resembles "a book being written about Charlie Kirk's trial leading up to a September 10th execution like St. Thomas More."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify any actual book project matching this description.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Parents Have Not Reached Out to Candace
claims.claim: Per host statement read aloud from comment thread context, Charlie Kirk's parents have not reached out to Candace Owens to validate her investigation, though they have historically been private.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through any other public statements from Charlie Kirk's parents or family representatives.
